# RoofScan UK

> RoofScan UK carries out drone roof inspections and writes a roof condition report for homeowners, home buyers, landlords, letting agents, block managers and businesses. We cover the south of England for now, growing across the UK. We inspect and report only. We do not do repairs, so the report has no reason to find work that is not there.

## Key facts (checked 21 November 2026)

- Business: RoofScan UK is the trading name of Takhy Ndiaye Marrero, a sole trader.
- What we do: a drone pilot photographs the roof from the air, including the slopes, chimney stacks, flashing and gutters. Nobody climbs on the roof. You then get a written report with photos, a condition rating for each part of the roof, a RoofScore out of 100 and a schedule of works.
- What we do not do: repairs or roofing work. The report is an external visual inspection of the roof. It is not a structural survey and does not replace a RICS survey.
- Where: the south of England for now, growing across the UK. Enter a postcode on the website to check an address.
- Roof report prices (standard pitched roof, priced by the footprint of the house): terraced from £255, semi detached from £296, detached from £406, large detached from £563. Flat roofs cost a little less and mixed roofs a little more. Roofs over 400m² footprint are quoted personally.
- Add ons: chimney stacks £35 each, dormer windows £20 each, extensions or flat roofs £30, outbuildings or garages £40.
- Thermal leak scans: from £350, flown after dark, priced by roof size. Offered only where a thermal pilot covers the address; the thermal quote page checks the postcode.
- Prices shown online are estimates. The final price is confirmed after the flight.
- Travel: no travel charge within 10 road miles of the nearest pilot, then 90p per extra road mile, shown before booking.
- Booking: online, with a £50 deposit that comes off the total. Inspections from 72 hours' notice, or 48 hours with Express.
- Report time: the written report arrives within 5 working days of paying the balance, or within 24 hours of paying the balance with Express (£99 extra).
- On the day: usually 30 minutes to an hour on site. Nobody needs to be home.
- Pilots: every pilot's CAA Operator ID, Flyer ID and insurance are checked before they fly for RoofScan UK. Copies are available on request.
- Trade accounts: roofing and main contractors can book reports on a trade account, priced by footprint, with one invoice at the end of each month. Ask through the website.
- Phone: 07498 364197

## For referral partners

- [Referral partnerships](https://roofscanuk.co.uk/join.html): estate and letting agents, block managers, solicitors and roofers. For every referred report paid in full, the firm receives £50, or 10% of the job on bigger jobs, whichever is higher, paid once a month.
